name: storepi-api-tests
description: StorePI API test suite using Postman and Newman

scripts.smoke: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('reports',{recursive:true})" && newman run "StorePI API Test Automation.postman_collection.json" -e "StorePI Test Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "01 Smoke & Catalog" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export "reports/StorePI_Smoke_Report.html"
scripts.auth: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('reports',{recursive:true})" && newman run "StorePI API Test Automation.postman_collection.json" -e "StorePI Test Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "02 Authentication" --env-var runMutations=true -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export "reports/StorePI_Auth_Report.html"
scripts.e2e: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('reports',{recursive:true})" && newman run "StorePI API Test Automation.postman_collection.json" -e "StorePI Test Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "08 E2E Workflow (explicit opt-in)" --env-var runMutations=true -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export "reports/StorePI_E2E_Report.html"
scripts.negative: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('reports',{recursive:true})" && newman run "StorePI API Test Automation.postman_collection.json" -e "StorePI Test Environment.postman_environment.json" --folder "09 Negative & Authorization Checks" --env-var runNegativeTests=true -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export "reports/StorePI_Negative_Report.html"
scripts.reports:safe: npm run smoke && npm run negative
